description: This file defines the class InstallOnExistingDatabaseCommand, which extends functionality for installing a system onto an existing database within the OrangeHRM application. It includes methods for configuring database connection details and verifying database state during installation.

classes.name: InstallOnExistingDatabaseCommand
classes.description: A class responsible for handling the installation process on an already existing database, including collecting database configuration and performing validation checks.

methods.name: getCommandName
methods.description: Returns the command name identifier used for CLI invocation.

methods.name: databaseInformation
methods.description: Handles user prompts to input database connection details and validates the provided database state.
